title: Hantu Karaoke
overview: Abu Bakar, who goes to the karaoke center to alleviate his sadness, meets Cumi, a woman who is inside a karaoke room and sings with him. However, Abu Bakar is unaware that Cumi is the woman who choked on peanuts while singing in the karaoke room and was thrown into a pit by her boyfriend. Abu Bakar is shocked, frightened, and tries to run, but Cumi stops him and pleads to help her complete her body.
